commonMistakes.tr: Forward zone yerine reverse zone karistirmak, PTR unutmak veya eski kayit conflict'i en sik hatalardir.
commonMistakes.en: Mixing forward and reverse zones, forgetting PTR, and old record conflicts are common mistakes.

verificationChecks.tr: nslookup, ping, ipconfig /flushdns, zone replication ve duplicate record kontrolu yap.
verificationChecks.en: Run nslookup, ping, ipconfig /flushdns, and check zone replication and duplicate records.

expertTips.tr: Kayit sonrasi nslookup, ping ve duplicate kayit kontrolu yap; replikasyon gecikmesini hesaba kat.
expertTips.en: After creating the record, run nslookup, ping, and duplicate record checks; account for replication delay.

expertTips.tr: Yanlis TTL ve replikasyon gecikmesi 'kayit calismiyor' sikayetlerinin sik nedenidir.
expertTips.en: Wrong TTL and replication delay are frequent causes of 'record not working' reports.

verificationChecks.tr: Forward/reverse zone secimini ve scavenging ayarlarini dogrula.
verificationChecks.en: Verify forward/reverse zone selection and scavenging settings.
